# LawCopilot

> Legal AI for law firms and in-house legal teams in India. It reads the record, researches and drafts, then checks with you before anything leaves.

LawCopilot takes on document briefs, paper books, tabular reviews, drafting and cause-list watching. Every statement is cited to its source: the page in the record, the judgment or the provision. Data is stored in India and never used to train AI models. Built by Lawinit Private Limited, with offices in Hyderabad and Visakhapatnam.
